title: Among all drivers who finished races held at circuits in Spain between 2008
question: Among all drivers who finished races held at circuits in Spain between 2008 and 2010, identify those with British nationality. For these British drivers, what was their fastest lap speed recorded across all their completed races during this period?

prediction.sql:
SELECT MAX(CAST(r.XCL_089 AS REAL)) AS fastest_lap_speed
FROM results AS r
JOIN races AS rc ON rc.XCL_065 = r.XCL_074
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.XCL_001 = rc.XCL_068
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.XCL_034 = r.XCL_075
WHERE c.XCL_005 = 'Spain'
  AND rc.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2008 AND 2010
  AND d.XCL_041 = 'British'
  AND r.XCL_089 IS NOT NULL
